title: docs(widgets): update Widgets API
body:
This PR updates the *Common Widgets API* tutorial by:

- replacing `transformData` with `transformItems`
- removing `collapsible` and `autoHideContainer`
- fixing examples (the `instantsearch.widgets` namespace was missing)
- reworking examples
- formatting examples

**[See preview →](https://deploy-preview-3184--algolia-instantsearch.netlify.com/v2/widgets-common-api.html)**
